# Atelier

The register of a maker's catalogue held in still air: limewash paper with a slow, luminous haze moving behind it, deep umber ink, Sentient light in heads and statements, Hanken Grotesk for reading, hairlines, one slate signal nearly as dark as the ink. The things a house hands you (a sample strip, a card, a numbered print) are built on cotton stock, lit from the top left, with pressed type and fibre. Not a cream page with a thin luxury serif, not a product page with a blue button.

## Tokens

```css
:root {
  --color-paper: oklch(94.5% 0.010 76); --color-paper-2: oklch(91.8% 0.013 74); --color-paper-3: oklch(88% 0.015 72);
  --color-ink: oklch(19% 0.024 52); --color-ink-2: oklch(31% 0.018 54); --color-muted: oklch(47% 0.014 60);
  --color-rule: oklch(81% 0.011 70);
  --color-accent: oklch(41% 0.075 248); --color-accent-ink: oklch(96% 0.008 76); --color-focus: oklch(50% 0.095 248);
  --color-card: oklch(97.6% 0.007 82); --color-card-edge: oklch(86% 0.012 72); --color-pencil: oklch(52% 0.010 62);
  --card-lit: oklch(98.4% 0.006 84); --card-shade: oklch(96.4% 0.008 78); --lit: oklch(99.6% 0.004 85 / 0.9);
  --stain-1: oklch(70% 0.075 14); --stain-2: oklch(66% 0.055 132); --stain-3: oklch(60% 0.080 58); --stain-4: oklch(68% 0.045 206);
  --font-display: "Sentient", Georgia, serif; --font-body: "Hanken Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-outlier: var(--font-body);
  --radius-card: 0; --radius-pill: 3px; --rule-hair: 1px; --rule-head: 1px;
  --shadow-card: 0 0 0 1px oklch(30% 0.03 55 / 0.05), 0.5px 1px 1px oklch(30% 0.03 55 / 0.08), 3px 8px 14px -6px oklch(30% 0.03 55 / 0.14), 14px 36px 64px -28px oklch(30% 0.03 55 / 0.3);
  --tracking-display: -0.018em; --tracking-statement: -0.022em; --display-weight: 300; --statement-weight: 300; --serif-small: 400;
}
```

## Type

- **Display and statement:** Sentient 300 for every head and for a sentence or a figure at `--text-display-s` or larger, line-height 1.02 to 1.1, sentence case, roman. One weight and one colour a head.
- **Small serif:** Sentient 400 for `h3`, a name on a card, a day, an entry numeral; never under 16px, never a paragraph.
- **Body:** Hanken Grotesk 400, line-height 1.6, `--color-ink-2`. Three weights a page: Sentient 300 and 400, Hanken 400.
- **Labels:** the wall label: Hanken 400 a step smaller, sentence case, untracked; the object in ink, the material or number in `--color-muted`. A numbered edition is pencilled: a blank rule for the hand, then the run, in `--color-pencil`.

## Surfaces

- The air: one fixed WebGL field behind the page, domain-warped noise drifting upward in cream and pale amber veils, mixed in linear light, rendered at half size; the pointer's recent path parts it and a chosen item tints it. It shows through the hero and one or two zones; paper sections cover it. A still frame of the same field is the fallback. Never a gradient blob, never a photograph.
- Texture is generated as feTurbulence data URIs: `--grain` (180px, 1.15) multiplied at 0.16 over the air, `--fibre` (220px, 0.85) on all card stock.
- Card stock: cotton in `--color-card`, 2px corners, `--shadow-card`, an inset lit edge top left, an inner hairline frame inset 14px in `--color-card-edge`; type on it is pressed (a 1px lit text shadow below).
- Sample strips: slim cotton blotters with a pointed tip, the item's stain wicking up from the tip, the name printed small and vertical. They fan from a rivet beside a head, hang from a rail as tabs (the chosen one let down on a thread), or tuck behind a card.
- Hairlines on rows; a table or list opens on an ink `--rule-head` rule. Photographs: still life and rooms in warm daylight, hung square with a wall label; the lead picture is a print on a thin cotton mat with a fine bevel and its edition pencilled beneath.

## Range

- **Statement:** one sentence of the prompt in Sentient 300 across nine or ten columns, the pencilled edition line and a wall-text paragraph opening on a slate drop cap.
- **The choice as strips:** the collection as blotters on a rail, each a real tab; the chosen one drops, its picture and wall label beside it.
- **Timetable:** days or hours as a ruled table under the ink rule, names in Sentient 400, a closed row muted, never struck through.
- **The booking as a card:** the form as a letterpress card on cotton: the house name pressed, a ringed day picker (a blind impression around the chosen day), engraved time chips, ruled lines to write on, strips tucked behind.

## Controls

- A hairline-outlined control in ink at 3px (hover fills ink, paper text) beside an underlined link with a slate underline. No colour-filled control.
- Choices on card stock are pressed in: inset shade top left, lit edge below; chosen takes a 1px ink ring. Fields on a card are a label over a ruled line.
- The slate stays under 4% of a screen: underlines, the drop cap, the focus ring.

## Motion

Fade-in after fonts; strips unfurl once on `--ease-out` over `--dur-long`; the air drifts, parts and tints, paused off screen. Reduced motion and no script: a still air, the first item chosen.

## Voice

Hand-set, object-precise: the object, the material, the number made, the days the door is open. No superlatives, never "shop now" or "discover".

## Do-nots

- Never a warm accent; the signal is cool slate under chroma 0.09.
- Never a bold or high-contrast head; Sentient light carries the voice.
- Never serif running text.
- Never a flat white card or a blurred glass panel; card stock has fibre, a lit edge and one light from the top left.
- Never two still lifes side by side at one size.

## Build hint

```html
<link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=sentient@300,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hanken+Grotesk:wght@400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

```css
body { color: var(--color-ink-2); line-height: 1.6; }
h1, h2 { font-weight: var(--display-weight); color: var(--color-ink); } h3 { font-weight: var(--serif-small); }
.ruled { border-top: var(--rule-head) solid var(--color-ink); } .ruled > * + * { border-top: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--color-rule); }
.dropcap::first-letter { float: left; font: var(--serif-small) 3.3em/0.8 var(--font-display); padding: 0.1em 0.1em 0 0; color: var(--color-accent); }
.btn { min-height: 52px; border: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); padding: 0 var(--space-lg); color: var(--color-ink); background: transparent; transition: background-color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out); }
.btn:hover { background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); }
.stock { border-radius: 2px; background: var(--fibre) 0 0 / 220px, linear-gradient(160deg, var(--card-lit), var(--color-card) 55%, var(--card-shade)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card), inset 1px 1px 0 var(--lit); text-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--lit); }
.stock::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0.875rem; border: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--color-card-edge); }
.air::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: var(--grain); background-size: 180px; opacity: 0.16; mix-blend-mode: multiply; }
```

# Blueprint

A drafting sheet as a material: Prussian-blue paper, a white line for ink, Chakra Petch drafted capitals over IBM Plex Sans, mono measurements with their units, keylines instead of cards, and photographs printed as cyanotypes, the sheet's blue in the shadows and its white in the light. It reads technical because everything is a line, a dimension or a print on one ground and the line is the only signal. It is not a dark product page with a blue gradient, not a neon wireframe.

## Tokens

```css
:root {
  --color-paper: oklch(35% 0.105 256); --color-paper-2: oklch(31% 0.10 257); --color-paper-3: oklch(26.5% 0.095 258);
  --color-ink: oklch(97% 0.012 240); --color-ink-2: oklch(90% 0.025 242); --color-muted: oklch(80% 0.045 244);
  --color-rule: oklch(93% 0.02 240 / 0.85); --color-rule-2: oklch(93% 0.02 240 / 0.32);
  --color-grid: oklch(97% 0.01 240 / 0.09); --color-grid-2: oklch(97% 0.01 240 / 0.2);
  --color-accent: oklch(97% 0.012 240); --color-accent-ink: oklch(33% 0.105 256); --color-focus: oklch(97% 0.012 240);
  --font-display: "Chakra Petch", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; --font-body: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --font-outlier: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  --radius-card: 0; --radius-pill: 0; --rule-hair: 1px; --rule-heavy: 2px; --shadow-card: none;
  --tracking-display: -0.012em; --display-weight: 600; --sheet-inset: 20px; --tick: 14px;
}
```

Three sheets, stated in the stamp (`blueprint: cyanotype`).

| Sheet | Ground, line, muted |
| --- | --- |
| **cyanotype** (default) | the tokens above |
| **whiteprint** | ground `oklch(97.5% 0.006 240)`, ink `oklch(35% 0.105 256)`, muted `oklch(52% 0.07 255)` |
| **brownline** | ground `oklch(86% 0.045 80)`, ink `oklch(28% 0.05 50)`, muted `oklch(45% 0.05 55)`, a red pencil `oklch(45% 0.19 28)` for annotation only |

## Type

- **Display:** Chakra Petch 600 for every head, `--tracking-display`, roman, one weight a head: the h1 and h2 uppercase at line-height 1.02 (55a), the h3 in sentence case.
- **Body:** IBM Plex Sans 400 for prose and 500 for labels and controls; reversed on the sheet, nothing lighter than 400.
- **Labels, captions, table heads, meta:** IBM Plex Sans 500 a step smaller, sentence case. IBM Plex Mono 500 sets a measurement with its unit, a stage or drawing number, a year on a dimension string and code, nothing else.

## Surfaces

- Lines only: 1px `--color-rule` keylines on every surface, and a second keyline in `--color-rule-2` 5px inside on a figure or a photograph. Radius 0, no shadows; depth is a second line, a `--rule-heavy` line or a one-step darker ground.
- The dimension string: a hairline with a 45° tick (`--tick` long) at each end and short extension lines, its value set above it. It measures something real, never a decoration.
- The grid: 24px minor lines in `--color-grid`, 120px major in `--color-grid-2`, offset by `--sheet-inset`, only under a drawing, a schedule or a chart of real data.
- Bands: `--color-paper-2` or `--color-paper-3`, two a page at most; the sheet is already the colour (drenched), so there is no other field.
- Photographs: structures built and building, shot square-on so they read like drawings (a frame going up, a roof from below, a model on a table), printed as cyanotypes inside the double keyline; pick frames with a real white and a real shadow, since grey prints flat. Type over one sits on a `--color-paper-3` scrim from its edge.

## Range

- **Figures as dimensions:** the prompt's one number in Chakra Petch at display size, set on a dimension string that spans ten or twelve columns between its two real ends (a first year and now, a smallest and largest span), the ends in mono.
- **Tables as drawing registers:** a stage schedule, a deliverables list or a price list as a keylined table, stage numbers in mono in their own column, the row title one weight heavier, a `--rule-heavy` line under the head row; on `--color-paper-2` it reads as the register sheet of a set.
- **Forms as a title block:** fields set as cells of a keylined block, each label at the cell's top left, the cells sized by what they hold, the submit in the ink fill at the block's foot.
- **Comparisons and steps as elevations:** two options side by side as columns parted by one heavy line, or stages as a run along one long dimension string with a tick at each stage, each stage a numeral, a title and a line.

## Controls

- An ink-filled primary with sheet-coloured text beside a 1px-outlined secondary in ink, both square, 48px, IBM Plex Sans 500.
- Links in ink with a 1px underline that clears on hover; inputs square, 48px, a 1px `--color-rule` keyline on `--color-paper-2`, the white focus ring, never a glow.
- The line is the accent: white on blue, in rules, the primary fill and the focus ring.

## Motion

Static, drafted. A rule or a dimension string may draw itself once a page (scaleX from its left tick over `--dur-long` on `--ease-out`); hover on a keylined surface that links darkens its ground one step.

## Voice

Specification voice: the building type, the stage, the year, the format, a unit on every figure; nothing a drawing note could not carry.

## Do-nots

- Never a filled card, a blur or a lifted panel; the sheet has lines, not layers.
- Never a second colour on the cyanotype, in type or in a photograph; the red pencil belongs to the brownline sheet.
- Never a building, frame or section drawn to stand in for a project, and never a dimension string with an invented value; a drawing is real project data or it is absent.
- Never the grid as wallpaper behind prose, and never a lowercase h1 or h2.
- Never a rounded corner, anywhere.

## Build hint

```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chakra+Petch:wght@600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

```css
h1, h2, h3 { font-weight: 600; }
h1, h2 { text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.02; }
.num { font-family: var(--font-outlier); font-weight: 500; }
.fig { position: relative; border: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--color-rule); }
.fig::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 5px; z-index: 2; border: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--color-rule-2); pointer-events: none; }
.dim { position: relative; height: var(--rule-hair); background: var(--color-rule); }
.dim::before, .dim::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: calc(var(--tick) / -2); width: var(--rule-hair); height: var(--tick); background: var(--color-rule); transform: rotate(45deg); }
.dim::before { left: 0; } .dim::after { right: 0; }
.btn { border: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg); font-weight: 500; }
.btn--primary { background: var(--color-ink); border-color: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-accent-ink); }
```

# Broadside

A printer's bill: grained buff stock, near-black ink, Six Caps fitted to the measure over Bevan, Archivo Narrow small print, rules at one point or five, one vermilion. It is loud because the capitals are tall and the rules heavy, never because anything is drawn; photographs print plainly in the ink, like the plate on a sale bill. Not a western pastiche, nor a soft cream editorial page.

## Tokens

```css
:root {
  --color-paper: oklch(92% 0.028 88); --color-paper-2: oklch(88.5% 0.032 88); --color-paper-3: oklch(85% 0.036 86);
  --color-ink: oklch(18% 0.01 50); --color-ink-2: oklch(30% 0.012 50); --color-muted: oklch(43% 0.02 62);
  --color-rule: oklch(75% 0.028 82);
  --color-accent: oklch(53% 0.19 33); --color-accent-ink: oklch(95.5% 0.018 88); --color-focus: oklch(53% 0.19 33);
  --font-display: "Six Caps", "Impact", sans-serif; --font-display-2: "Bevan", Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif;
  --font-outlier: var(--font-body);
  --radius-card: 0; --radius-pill: 0; --rule-hair: 1px; --rule-bar: 5px; --rule-frame: 3px;
  --shadow-card: none;
  --tracking-display: 0.02em; --display-weight: 400;
  --grain: 0.08;
}
```

One dial, the colourway, stated in the stamp (`broadside: bill`).

| Colourway | Stock | Ink | Accent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bill` (default) | the block above | ink | vermilion |
| `inked` | oklch(17% 0.01 60), grain screened | buff oklch(92% 0.028 88) | vermilion at oklch(63% 0.19 33); paper band dark |
| `red-bill` | the vermilion | buff oklch(95.5% 0.018 88), 5.5:1 | buff; posture drenched |

## Type

- **Six Caps** 400, uppercase, line-height 0.88, `--tracking-display`, for the h1, big figures and fitted lines. It is fitted, not stepped: each line its own element that never wraps (`white-space: nowrap`, the 55b guard), its size set from its measured width in `cqi` so it fills its column exactly; lines stacked in one block differ in size, as type set by hand does.
- **Bevan** 400 for section heads, item titles, the wordmark and short lines of fact; uppercase, untracked, line-height 1.
- **Archivo Narrow** 400 and 600, line-height 1.5, for everything read; labels, table heads, captions and meta in its 500 a step smaller, sentence case, untracked, `--color-muted`. Figures are Six Caps, or Archivo Narrow tabular in a row.
- Three families, no outlier: one case of wood type, the gothic for scale and the slab for weight.

## Surfaces

- Rules: `--rule-bar` in ink above a section, a table or between two columns of a bill, `--rule-hair` in ink under a running head, `--rule-hair` in `--color-rule` between rows. Nothing between one and five.
- Square corners everywhere, no shadow. A frame is a double rule, a `--rule-frame` ink border with a 1px ink keyline 3px inside it, round a well or a photograph.
- Bands: `--color-paper-2`, ink with buff type, or one vermilion band with buff type; two a page at most.
- Photographs: plain daylight documentary at eye level, the thing for sale whole and side-on, a detail at arm's length; nobody facing the lens. Printed in the ink on the stock (the `photo:` duotone), square, in the double-rule frame; type never sits on one, and a caption under it carries a fact.
- Grain, the only texture: the speck layer (`texture.md` § 1) at `--grain`, multiplied on buff and screened on ink, on bands, wells and photograph frames, never under running text.

## Range

- A timetable as a bill: each day a column under a five-point rule, its name fitted in Six Caps to the column, the hour in Bevan, the small print under a 1pt rule; columns parted by a five-point vertical rule.
- A count or a date fitted to the full measure in Six Caps, the one vermilion line of its screen, its small print beneath.
- Particulars as rows: a Bevan label on the left, the fact in Archivo Narrow 600 on the right, hair rules between, a five-point rule over the first; a fact not yet known prints as a muted fill, never invented.
- A form on the vermilion band: buff fields with an ink keyline, the ink block as its action, the head in Bevan.

## Controls

- An ink-filled block in Archivo Narrow 600, untracked capitals (legal under an uppercase display), beside the same block as an unfilled double-rule frame; square, 48px, one fill a page.
- Links in ink, underlined, vermilion on hover; inputs square, 48px, a 1px ink border.
- Vermilion sets one whole display line (its own element, never part of a head) or one figure a screen, on buff or `--color-paper-2`.

## Motion

Printed, so still: a live figure updates in place, a fitted line fits once when the fonts load. No marquee, no hover growth, no reveal.

## Voice

A sale bill read aloud: the date, the place, the lot and the hour, each said once. Shouted in capitals, explained in the small print, in the words of the trade it sells to.

## Do-nots

- Never a ragged big line; a Six Caps line that does not fill its measure is fitted or cut.
- Never a fourth face outside code: the case is Six Caps, Bevan and the narrow.
- Never a rounded corner; frames, controls and photographs are square.
- Never a second colour, in type or in a picture; photographs print in the ink.
- Never a drawn gavel, star or ornament; the capitals and the photograph are the loud things.
- Never a photograph on every fold; half the bill is type, and the type is the loud half.

## Build hint

```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Six+Caps&family=Bevan&family=Archivo+Narrow:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

```css
h1, .display { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 0.88; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display); }
.fit { display: block; white-space: nowrap; }
h2, h3, .wordmark { font-family: var(--font-display-2); font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0; }
.rule-bar { border-top: var(--rule-bar) solid var(--color-ink); }
.frame, .btn--frame { border: var(--rule-frame) solid var(--color-ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--color-paper), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--color-ink); }
.frame { padding: var(--space-lg); } .frame--photo { padding: var(--space-2xs); }
.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 var(--space-xl); border: 3px solid var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); font: 600 var(--text-sm)/1 var(--font-body); text-transform: uppercase; }
.btn--frame { background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); }
.grained { position: relative; isolation: isolate; }
.grained::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: var(--grain); mix-blend-mode: multiply; } /* the speck SVG, texture.md § 1 */
::selection { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 30%, transparent); }
```

# Brutal

A raw, engineered sheet: near-white poster stock, near-black ink that arrives as 3px rules, boxed cells and solid fills, Libre Franklin at its blackest in tight capitals, zero radius, and one acid yellow that only ever fills. The grid is drawn, not implied: cells share their rules, and a number or a word set big inside a box is the page's ornament. Photographs print hard in the ink. It is not a dark hacker page, not a decorated zine and not a sticker sheet of offset shadows.

## Tokens

```css
:root {
  --color-paper: oklch(97.5% 0.006 95); --color-paper-2: oklch(94% 0.007 95); --color-paper-3: oklch(89.5% 0.008 95);
  --color-ink: oklch(10% 0.006 95); --color-ink-2: oklch(16% 0.006 95); --color-muted: oklch(40% 0.008 95);
  --color-rule: oklch(10% 0.006 95);
```

# Garden

A grower's voice: warm oat paper, a near-black green ink, Vollkorn heads and old-style figures over Hanken Grotesk, hairlines, soft moss and clay tints, the place photographed in daylight, one leaf-green signal. It feels honest and seasonal because every neutral leans green, the fruit keeps its real colour and nothing is boxed, glossy or grey. It is not a sage-and-slate wellness page and not a cream bookshop with a terracotta accent.

## Type

- **Display:** Vollkorn 600, roman, sentence case, `--tracking-display`, line-height 1.04; one weight for every head, never italic. Sturdy without the 700's thickness, so a 52px head reads as set, not shouted. Its old-style figures are the theme's best numbers: an acreage or a count in Vollkorn at 160px and over, descending below the line, needs no other picture.
- **Body:** Hanken Grotesk 400 and 500 with `oldstyle-nums`; tables take lining tabular numerals, display figures keep Vollkorn's old-style ones.
- **Captions under a photograph (the outlier):** Newsreader 400 at the label size, sentence case, in `--color-muted`, one fact a line, like a nursery's label. Vollkorn never runs as body.
- **Labels, table heads, meta, lot codes, dates:** Hanken Grotesk 500 a step smaller, sentence case, untracked, `--color-muted`. No mono on the page.

## Surfaces

- Rules: 1px `--color-rule` hairlines part rows and sections; `--color-rule-2` tops a table or outlines a control. Radius 4px on wells and photographs, pills on controls.
- Depth is flat paper: no shadow, no drop-shadowed box; a well is `--color-paper-2` or a tint, never a bordered card.

A head sits on a photograph only over an ink scrim at 40 to 60%.
- Every neutral carries a green or oat cast (hue 90 to 152), never a pure grey. No texture.

## Range

- **Figures in old-style numerals:** the prompt's acreage, varieties or jars in Vollkorn 600 at 160px and over, three across on hairlines, a Hanken line beneath each.
- **The season as a ruled strip:** the twelve months in one hairline row, the open ones on the moss tint with what happens in them, the rest left as paper; under it the hours and the place as two-column rows.
- **A price list or produce list:** hairline rows on paper-2 or the green ink, the name in Vollkorn at item size, a Newsreader note, the price in lining figures at the right edge; a missing fact stays a labelled placeholder.
- **A statement on green ink:** one sentence in Vollkorn at section size and over in oat, the action in pale leaf beneath.

## Controls

- One flat leaf-green pill with `--color-accent-ink` text beside a hairline-outlined pill in `--color-rule-2`.
- Links in ink, underlined, the line turning leaf green on hover; inputs at 4px with a 1px `--color-muted` border on oat.
- Leaf green stays under 5% of a screen: the primary, a link's hover, the focus ring, one figure. Clay lives in its tint band only, never on a control, a nav or a head.

## Motion

State only, `--dur-short` on `--ease-out`: a pill darkens one step, an underline grows under a link. No reveal, no stagger, no parallax.

## Voice

Warm, honest, seasonal, unhurried. Say the field, the variety, the month, the acreage, the number of jars, only as the prompt gives them; never artisanal, curated or small-batch as a hollow badge.

## Do-nots

- Never grey-sage or slate paper; the ground is warm oat, hue 92.
- Never a cool teal or corporate emerald; the green is chlorophyll, hue 140.
- Never italic or faux-bold Vollkorn; load the real 600, and never mix it with 700 on one page.
- Never clay on a control or a head, and never a gradient on the leaf-green pill.
- Never produce styled on white or a staged picnic; the place is a working one.

Photographs are the only full colour, close and bright like a label's product shot. # Ink

A notice printed in plain black: white paper, a black with no hue, Epilogue at 700 for the head and 400 for everything you read, hairline rules, and one teal that means in or open. Its photographs show the things on the shelves, in daylight with the colour turned down. It feels competent, local and kind, the way a well-run community desk does. It is not a cold corporate monochrome and not a warm cream editorial page.

## Tokens

```css
:root {
  --color-paper: oklch(99.5% 0.003 100); --color-paper-2: oklch(97% 0.004 100); --color-paper-3: oklch(94% 0.006 100);
  --color-ink: oklch(16% 0 0); --color-ink-2: oklch(28% 0 0); --color-muted: oklch(44% 0 0);
  --color-rule: oklch(89% 0.004 100); --color-rule-2: oklch(93.5% 0.003 100);
  --color-accent: oklch(50% 0.095 188); --color-accent-ink: oklch(99.5% 0.003 100); --color-accent-soft: oklch(93% 0.05 190); --color-accent-soft-ink: oklch(27% 0.045 190);
  --color-focus: oklch(50% 0.095 188);
  --font-display: "Epilogue", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; --font-body: var(--font-display);
  --font-outlier: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  --radius-card: 12px; --radius-pill: 999px; --rule-hair: 1px;
  --shadow-card: 0 20px 40px oklch(20% 0 0 / 0.16);
  --tracking-display: -0.04em; --display-weight: 700;
}
```

Two colourways, both light, stated in the stamp (`ink: paper` or `ink: board`).

| Colourway | Ground and teal |
| --- | --- |
| `paper` (default) | the block above: white, hueless black, teal at 50% |
| `board` | notice-board yellow `oklch(93% 0.10 95)` with rules at `oklch(84% 0.10 92)`, ink `oklch(20% 0.02 80)`, teal deepened to `oklch(46% 0.078 190)`; wells and tags turn white |

## Type

- **Display:** Epilogue 700, `--tracking-display`, line-height 1.0 at hero size and 1.05 below, sentence case, roman; a figure (a count, a price, an hour) takes the same setting, a step larger than the head beside it.
- **Body:** Epilogue 400 at 16 to 17px, line-height 1.55, in `--color-ink-2` (muted greys tire on white); the name in a row, links and tags at 600.
- **Labels, captions, table heads, meta:** Epilogue 400 a step smaller, sentence case, untracked; never mono.
- **Outlier:** IBM Plex Mono only inside code and on figures that compare in a column (loan counts, a card number, times on a rota). Large figures and prices are Epilogue 700 in ink; the teal marks only what is in or open.

## Surfaces

- Rules: a list or a table opens on a 1px `--color-ink` rule and continues on `--color-rule` hairlines between its rows; `--color-rule-2` parts quieter rows.
- Radius 12px on wells and photographs, 10px on controls and inputs, pills on tags.
- Flat paper: a well is `--color-paper-2` with a 1px `--color-rule` edge; `--shadow-card` sits only under something that floats over the page (a menu, a dialog), never under a surface at rest.
- Bands: a `--color-paper-2` band or an ink band with paper text. Two a page at most; never a teal field.
- Photographs: the things and the street that shares them, in plain daylight at arm's length: a pegboard of tools, a ladder against a wall, a neighbour carrying something home, seen from behind; no face to the lens, no brand mark to the camera. The colour is turned down (the `photo:` muted) so the teal stays the one colour that means anything; 12px radius, a 1px `--color-rule` hairline, no shadow. A thing's name and its state tag sit under its picture, never on it.
- No texture.

## Range

- **The shelf as a ruled list:** every thing a row under the ink rule, its name at 600, one line on what it is, its state pill at the row's end, a filter field that narrows the rows as you type.
- **Steps as a notice:** how it works as three or four numbered stages across the columns, each numeral in Epilogue 700 at display size over a hairline, the stage that means in carrying the pale teal pill.
- **A timetable of opening days:** the next dates as rows, the hours in each, the next one inked; the dates come from the clock, never typed in.
- **Figures in plain black:** a count, a fee and the hours set large in Epilogue 700 on a `--color-paper-2` well, the one that means open in teal.

## Controls

- The pair: an ink-filled button with paper text beside a 1px `--color-rule` bordered button on `--color-paper-2`, both at 10px radius in Epilogue 600.
- Tags carry state and nothing else: in is pale teal (`--color-accent-soft`) with `--color-accent-soft-ink`, out is outlined in the rule colour, on is ink-filled.
- Teal means in or open: a tag, a large figure, a link's hover, the focus ring. Links are ink at 600, underlined, teal on hover.

## Motion

Nothing moves but state: a filter applies as you type, a tag changes state on click, an underline turns teal over `--dur-micro`. No marquee, no reveal, no counter.

## Voice

The desk volunteer's: what is in, when it is back, who is on Saturday. Short, kind, exact, never institutional.

## Do-nots

- Never a second colour: teal means in, and out is an outline, never red.
- Never a warm black. The ink has no hue, and the page says so: `waive 22 · ink and greys at zero chroma · a notice board is printed in plain black`.
- Never a teal field or teal running text; teal is a state, not a surface.
- Never a resting shadow; the paper stays flat.

## Build hint

```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Epilogue:wght@400;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

```css
.btn { border: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 10px; padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md); font-weight: 600; background: var(--color-paper-2); color: var(--color-ink); }
.btn--primary { background: var(--color-ink); border-color: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); }
.tag { display: inline-flex; padding: var(--space-2xs) var(--space-sm); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 600; background: var(--color-paper-3); }

.tag--out { background: transparent; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--rule-hair) var(--color-rule); color: var(--color-muted); }
```

# Kiln

A dark workshop with the kiln door open a crack: a near-black ground, cream ink, Boska's cut high-contrast serif over a plain Geist, and heat only where something is hot. The photographs carry the fire; a ramp from ash through oxblood, ember and amber to white heat colours a temperature as it climbs. Warm in one place, cold everywhere else. It is not a dark luxury page with an orange button, and not a glowing gradient poster.

## Tokens

```css

  --color-paper: oklch(13% 0.012 40); --color-paper-2: oklch(17.5% 0.016 40); --color-paper-3: oklch(22% 0.018 40);
```

Three colourways, stated in the stamp (`kiln: ember`).

| `ember` (default) | the block above |
| `bisque` | ground `oklch(96.5% 0.014 80)`, ink `oklch(20% 0.02 40)`, accent `oklch(54% 0.17 62)` with the ground as its text; the ramp starts at `oklch(90% 0.035 75)`; wells turn bone |
| `reduction` | ground `oklch(21% 0.06 22)`, ink `oklch(95% 0.02 85)`, accent `oklch(84% 0.12 62)`; the ramp begins at the ground |

## Type

- **Display:** Boska 500, `--tracking-display`, line-height 1.04, sentence case, roman, one colour per head; a statement set in it may run to `--text-display` at line-height 1.0.
- **Figures:** a temperature, a firing time or the price that carries the story is Boska 500, lining and tabular, at -0.03em, its unit (°C, h, £) in the same face; a lone figure may run twice the hero head.
- **Body:** Geist 400 and 500 at 16 to 18px, line-height 1.55.
- **Labels, captions, axis ticks, table heads:** Geist 500 a step smaller, sentence case, untracked, in `--color-muted`. Geist Mono only inside code.

Everything else is quiet: deep pool-blue ink, Funnel Display at a light weight, clear surfaces whose shadows carry a tint of the light that passed through them. | Dial | Options |
| --- | --- |
| **Light** (the generated ground) | `water` (default): caustics from a surface of moving water, a bright net over an aqua shade. `glass`: sun through a glazed window, the pane edges split warm and cool and a prism's fan crossing the patch, falling over the product as well as the ground, slow as the sun |
| **Colourway** | `pool` (default) as above. `noon`: ink `oklch(20% 0.01 260)`, accent near-black, the spectrum the only colour |

## Type

- **Display:** Funnel Display 400 (300 for a figure set at statement size), `--tracking-display`, line-height 1.02, sentence case, one colour. Heads stay calm; the light is the loud part.
- **Body:** Funnel Sans 400 at 17px, line-height 1.6, `--color-ink-2`; leads a step up in `--color-muted`.

## Surfaces

- **The light:** one generated canvas or shader, never a photograph of a texture and never a gradient blob. In `water` the shade is `--color-shade` with the net in `--color-light` and a faint split into `--spec-*` at the brightest seams; in `glass` the ground stays paper and bands of `--spec-*` fall at a low angle with a white cusp along one edge. - **Times to book as lanes:** when the visitor picks a session, the sessions as long ruled rows, the time in display figures, a status pill at the right edge, the next open row lit by a thin band of the light behind it.
- **A figure in sun:** one number at statement size in Funnel Display 300 with the light falling across the space beside it, its unit and source in one muted line.
- **The day as light:** a strip of hours as slim bars whose height is the light or the demand, the present hour marked by an accent dot, the rest in `--color-shade`.
- **The product on the table:** the product's real screen as a clear panel lying in the light, its cast shadow tinted, one working control that moves the light itself.

- Inputs are white wells with a hairline and `--radius-inner`; focus ring in `--color-focus`.
- The accent sits on the primary, focus, the present marker and links on hover; the spectrum lives only in the light.

## Motion

# Rim

# Riso

A small-press run from two drums and nothing else: bright uncoated stock, a medium blue drum that sets every word and a fluorescent pink drum for the fills, crossing in a purple nobody mixed. Cabinet Grotesk 800 heads over a Literata body, grain where the ink skips, one word a hair out of register. It reads handmade because the imperfection is in the ink, not in tape and scribbles.   --font-display: "Cabinet Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; --font-body: "Literata", ui-serif, Georgia, serif;
```css
  --radius-card: 2px; --radius-pill: 2px; --rule-hair: 1px;
  --shadow-card: none; --texture-opacity: 0.08;
  --tracking-display: -0.025em; --display-weight: 800;
}
```

## Type

- **Display:** Cabinet Grotesk 800, `--tracking-display`, sentence case, in the blue; `h1` leads 0.92, `h2` 0.98. A head is one weight and one colour. Figures that are the offer set in it, tabular.
- **The misregistered word** (stamp `waive 38iii`): one focal word in the hero head prints in both drums, a pink copy behind the blue nudged 2 to 3px down and right, so only its fringe shows (`texture.md` § 3). Once a page.
- **Body and lede:** Literata 400, opsz following size, in the blue.
- **Labels, captions, table heads, nav:** Literata 500 a step smaller, sentence case, `--color-muted` or the blue. No mono: figures take Literata's tabular numerals.

## Surfaces

- No black: every word, rule and icon prints in the blue drum, every fill in the pink; where pink overprints blue (`mix-blend-mode: multiply`) the purple shows, and nobody paints it.
- Screens of the pink drum are the papers: `--color-paper-2` (a light screen) under any text, `--color-paper-3` (half strength) under display type only, the solid pink with `--color-accent-ink`. The blue drum may print solid, with type knocked out to the stock. Two bands a page.
- Hairlines in `--color-rule`, 1.5px blue where a rule frames a figure, 2px radius, no shadow; depth is overprint.
- Photographs: the work and the room in even light, cropped close, with real tonal range. Each prints in both drums, blue shadows into a light pink screen (the `photo:` duotone), 2px radius, grain over it, captions beneath in Literata.
- Grain, declared: paper specks where the ink skips (`texture.md` § 1, light specks) on fills, bands and photographs at `--texture-opacity`, never under running text; grain and misregistration are one drum's family.

## Range

- **Figures** set as a two-ink overprint: the number in blue Cabinet 800 at display size, a solid pink shape multiplied across part of it, so the purple prints only where the drums cross. A price or a date carries a screen this way.
- **Steps** as separations: the same artwork shown as the blue layer alone, the pink layer alone, then the sheet with both, three plates on the stock in hairline frames; the process is the picture.
- **Rows and forms** on the light pink screen: a price list or an order as blue hairline rows in Literata tabular figures, a live total in the display face, the chosen row on the half screen.
- **Bands** in one drum at full strength: the solid blue with a statement knocked out to the stock and the pink primary on it, or the solid pink with deep blue type; a statement at display size is the loudest thing this material makes.

## Controls

- The pair: a pink-filled rectangle with `--color-accent-ink` type beside one outlined 1.5px in the blue, both at 2px radius in Cabinet Grotesk 800 at 15px; pressed, a control drops 1px down and right, the way a sheet lands.
- Links underline in pink, thicker on hover; inputs 48px tall at 2px radius with a 1.5px blue border on the stock, the value in Cabinet 800.
- Pink sits on the primary, link underlines and one fill a screen; the focus ring is blue.

## Motion

One reveal: the pink drum settles into its offset once on load over `--dur-long` on `--ease-out`, and never loops. Controls change colour over `--dur-short`; nothing else moves.

## Voice

Specific and hand-set: name the ink, the sheet, the drum and the price; verbs over adjectives. Imperfect on purpose.

- Never black ink or a grey; the only third colour is the purple the drums make.
- Never a registered, ungrained flat gradient; that is vector, not riso.
- Never pink as type on the stock; the pink drum fills, the blue one writes.
- Never the misregistration on a second head; one word, then rest.
- Never a page of duotone photographs back to back; the drums need a page of their own between pulls.

# Terminal

The page is the terminal surface, and its pictures are printed in type. A near-black ground with a green cast, pale phosphor ink, one bright phosphor green and a dim wash of it for what is added or selected, and Martian Mono for every glyph: heads wide, text narrow. A picture is printed as a grid of characters from the product's own text. It reads as a tool made by people who live in a shell. It is not the CRT costume and not a dark product page holding a screenshot of a terminal.

## Tokens

## Type

- **Every glyph is Martian Mono,** in three weights at most: 400, 500, 700. Display 500 at `--stretch-display`, line-height 1.12, `h1` at most 3.75rem in two or three lines. Body 400 at `--stretch-body`, 15 to 16px, line-height 1.65. Labels and meta a step smaller in `--color-muted`, sentence case, untracked.
- **Figures** set wide and light against the narrow text: 400 at `--stretch-display` from `--text-display-s` up, tabular, the unit or a `#` comment beneath in `--color-muted`.
- Prompt glyphs (`$`, `~ $`) in `--color-muted` mark real commands and only those; arguments in a reference take the accent.
- Martian Mono has no box-drawing or block glyphs. Diagrams are typed in `+ - |` and wordmarks printed as glyph pictures, so no fallback face slips into a line.

## Surfaces

- One hue, a ramp of lightness: ground, `--color-paper-2` for a session or an install well, `--color-paper-3` for hover and selection. Raised surfaces take a 1px `--color-rule` border, square, never a shadow; `--color-rule-2` is the firmer line under a table head or a diff's file header.
- Rules: 1px `--color-rule` between sections, rows and tabs.
- **Pictures as glyphs:** a picture with a strong silhouette on black, reduced to a grid of brightness levels (about 130 columns, cells 1.85 times as tall as wide) and drawn on a canvas, each lit cell one character of the product's text in `--glyph-0` to `--glyph-7`, dim cells at 62% size; a static `<pre>` stands in without script. One or two a page, big.
- When a glyph grid cannot be made, one photograph stands in, in the `photo:` duotone with a 1px `--color-rule` border: the machines themselves, never a screen showing an interface.
- No scanline, glow, bezel, title bar or traffic lights.

## Range

- **A comparison as a diff:** a unified diff across ten or twelve columns, a `--- a/` and `+++ b/` header over a `--color-rule-2` line, removed lines in `--color-muted` behind `-`, added lines in ink on `--color-accent-wash` behind a green `+`, a gutter of line numbers in `--color-rule-2`.
- **Figures as a tool's output:** three or four of the prompt's numbers at display size, wide and light, parted by vertical rules, each labelled by a `# comment` beneath, as `wc` or `du` would print them.
- **The session at size:** a session in a `--color-paper-2` well across eight columns or more, typed once, its output lighting a `+ - |` diagram beside it.
- **A reference as rows:** a command per row at `--text-title`, wide, its arguments in the accent, its line on the right, like a man page's synopsis; or a table of hosts, flags or exit codes.

## Controls

- Primary: an accent block with `--color-accent-ink` text, square. Secondary: a 1px `--color-ink-2` border. Hover and state switch in `steps(1)`.
- Install lines: a `--color-paper-2` well with tabs (brew, cargo, curl) underlined in the accent, the command at `--text-lg`, and a 16px copy icon at the right that turns into a tick in the accent for 1.4s.
- Links in `--color-ink-2`, underlined dotted, accent on hover; a selected row or tab takes `--color-accent-wash`.

## Motion

Stepped where it is state, alive where it is a picture: a glyph picture resolves row by row from noise over about 1.5s, once, and under the cursor its cells flare to the accent, then settle. A session types itself once when it enters the view. A caret blinks five times and holds. Reduced motion shows every final state.

## Voice

Commands, flags, paths and exit codes. Declarative and short: name the command, never the adjective.

## Do-nots

- Never a proportional face, and never a box-drawing glyph from a fallback font.
- Never a second hue: no amber, no cyan, no red for a removed line.
- Never a rounded corner, a pill or a soft card, and never a light section.
- Never more than one photograph, and only where glyphs cannot be made.

# Vantage

Reality capture at night: the thing itself, a site, a ridge, an object, rendered as tens of thousands of measured points on a blue-black ground, turning slowly while a sweep passes through and lights them. Around it the page is instrument-quiet: Geologica with its corners sharpened, steel-grey ink, hairline frames that only mark their corners, figures with their units. ## Type

- **Display:** Geologica 300 with `"SHRP" 100` (its sharpened corners), `--tracking-display`, line-height 1.0, sentence case; 400 for small titles. Heads are short and sit on plain ground, never on dense points.
- **Body:** Geologica 300 at 17px with `"SHRP" 0`, line-height 1.6, `--color-ink-2`.

## Surfaces

- **The cloud:** one generated canvas or WebGL scene of points only, no lines between them, no glow: size by distance, colour by height from `--point-lo` to `--point-hi`, a soft depth fade. A sweep plane passes every few seconds and lifts the points it touches toward white; anything found is lime. It fills the hero beside or behind the head and fades to paper at the edges.
- **Frames:** hairline `--color-rule` boxes are drawn only at their corners (`--tick` long ticks), around a measured thing or a panel; full hairline boxes only for inputs. Radius `--radius-card` at most.
- **Callouts:** a measured point carries a leader (a hairline with a 3px dot at the point) to its figure and unit; two at most on a screen.
- **Bands:** paper, and paper-2 for one quiet band; no lit or tinted bands. Flat depth, no shadows.
- **Photographs:** the real site or object in flat daylight, muted, `--radius-card`; never a sci-fi render.

## Range

- **A section cut:** one thin slice through the cloud set across the full width as a profile of points, with two or three heights called out by leader and figure.
- **A scan log as a table:** rows of captures with their date, area, points and accuracy in tabular figures, the live row marked by a lime dot.
- **Layers as working toggles:** ground, structures, canopy and found items as a ruled list of switches that really recolour or hide the cloud beside them.
- **A figure measured:** one number at statement size inside corner ticks, its tolerance under it in muted.

## Motion

The cloud turns slowly (a revolution in two minutes, an object in seventy seconds), the sweep passes every six to eight seconds on an ease-in-out, the pointer tilts the view a few degrees. Panels and rows fade up once. Canvas pauses off screen. Reduced motion: one still frame with the sweep stopped mid-scene.

## Voice

Measured and exact: what was scanned, how big, how accurate, how soon.

## Do-nots

- Never lines joining points, never a glow or bloom, never a grid floor receding to a horizon.
- Never more than one hue on the points besides lime for found.
- Never the cloud under running text or behind a form.
- Never a monospace label; figures are tabular Geologica.

Three colourways, set once per page and stated in the stamp (`werkstatt: putty`).

| Colourway | Ground, ink, primaries |
| --- | --- |
| `putty` (default) | the block above |
| `blackboard` | ground `oklch(17% 0.005 60)`, ink `oklch(90% 0.015 80)`, rule `oklch(38% 0.01 60)`, primaries a step brighter; putty returns as a well colour |
| `blue` | ground `oklch(50% 0.22 265)`, ink `oklch(93% 0.02 85)`, rule `oklch(64% 0.14 265)`; the yellow does the accent's work |

## Type

- **Display:** Jost 700, uppercase, `--tracking-display`, line-height 1.02, at the shared steps. Capitals are the material: every head is set in them. Numerals and dates take the same face at display size and up, tabular, inside their cell.
- **Body:** Karla 400, line-height 1.5.
- **Labels, captions, tags, table heads:** Karla 600 a step smaller, sentence case, untracked, in `--color-muted`. Small figures and prices in Karla with `tabular-nums`; mono only inside code.
- **Controls:** Karla 600 in capitals, following the display (the case gate 67 allows on an uppercase page), untracked.

## Surfaces

- Rules: `--rule-box` ink lines box and cross a grid, `--rule-bar` ink runs under a nav and over every table, `--rule-hair` in `--color-rule` between rows. No card has a background; a cell is what the rules enclose.
- Zero radius and zero shadow everywhere.
- Bands: a `--color-paper-2` band, an `--color-ink` band with paper text in the `blackboard` colours, or one blue field with `--color-accent-ink` text; two bands a page at most. `--color-paper-3` is a well inside a ruled cell, never a band.
- Photographs: the shops at work, documentary and plain, at bench height or from just above: a bench and its tools, hands at a plane, a press or a wheel, wood, type and clay close enough to read the grain; daylight, nobody facing the lens. Printed black and white (the `photo:` mono) so the primaries stay the only colour; square, in a `--rule-bar` ink border, flush with the cells around them. A shop's primary runs as the flat cell or bar beside or under its picture and carries the caption; it never tints the photograph, and type never sits on one.
- No texture, and no gradient anywhere.

## Range

- **Figures in boxed cells:** the prompt's real numbers in Jost 700 at display size, each in its own `--rule-box` cell across the twelve columns, the label in Karla beneath; no primary, since a set of one kind takes no colour.
- **Dates as a ruled schedule:** the deadline and the term set as rows of capitals as large as a section head, the day left, what happens right, a `--rule-bar` over the first row.
- **The categories as a coded grid:** each shop, track or room in its primary cell, flush with its neighbours, with a black and white photograph or a list of what it covers above the fill.
- **Forms as a ruled sheet:** fields boxed in a grid of cells like an entry form, the category choice in its primaries, the submit an ink block at the foot.

## Controls

- A transparent `--rule-bar` ink-bordered button beside an ink-filled one, both square; on an ink band the pair inverts: the filled one turns putty with ink type, never a primary, since the primaries code categories.
- Links carry a 2px ink underline that thickens to 3px on hover; inputs are square with a `--rule-bar` ink border.
- The primaries are flat fills, never type and never tints. Each codes one category, the same one wherever it appears (a cell, a tag, a band, a nav link), and a set of one kind takes no colour. Blue and red fills take `--color-accent-ink`, the red deepened to `--color-accent-2-deep`; a yellow fill takes ink. Blue also rings focus.

## Motion

Static, like a printed prospectus: a link's underline thickens on hover, and nothing else moves, reveals or loops.

## Voice

Plain school prose: the shop, the week, the tuition, the deadline, each said once and plainly.

## Do-nots

- Never a fourth colour, a tint of a primary, a primary used as type, or a photograph in colour.
- Never a radius on a container, a button or an image; Werkstatt is square.
- Never mixed-case display; Jost here is capitals.
- Never the primaries as confetti or a pattern; each fill means a category.
